MultipleTowersDI2.png|Default skin on a development image. }} ==Skin Trivia== *The first version of the Default skin was originally based on YouTuber [https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCojsj6T5tNPGPZSx7wn4coQ JOHN ROBLOX]. **On 16th of June 2019, the '''Paintballer''' was re-modelled to resemble a paintballer instead of [https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCojsj6T5tNPGPZSx7wn4coQ JOHN ROBLOX]. *Even though the {{Color|Premium|Green}} skin is only a recolor like skins from the [[Basic Crate]], it is a part of the [[Premium Crate]]. **However, unlike the other skins, it changes the colors of the '''Paintballer's''' projectile and explosions. ===Roblox Catalog=== *The original paintball gun wielded by the second version of the Default '''Paintballer''' and first version of the {{Color|Basic|Red}} '''Paintballer''' between Level 0-1 was the {{RLinkC|47532|Paintball Gun}} from Roblox BrickBattles. **The original paintball gun wielded between Level 2-5 was the {{RLinkC|172246669|Paintball Pro}} gear in the Roblox catalog. ***Currently, all skins between Levels 0-2 use the same mesh for their paintball gun, but with a different texture. *The second version of the Default Level 5 paintball mask is the {{RLinkC|1143322438|Neon Paintball Mask}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. ==Update History== {{scroll|text= *'''14 June 2019''' -
